result.reason: The operative language gives Corio, apparently the Customer, a convenience-termination right on 30 days’ written notice and requires a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, effectively satisfying the preferred pro-rata refund position. Commerce One receives no convenience-termination right during a committed term; the existing bilateral nonrenewal right applies only at term end. The change is limited to the required remedy and preserves the existing term and cause-based termination provisions. Drafting is professional, though numbering the added provision as 11.1.1 after Section 11.2 is structurally awkward and should be corrected.
